map.按每步耗时与步数估算单轮及总训练时长，适用于训练排期、算力预算与迭代周期规划。: Estimate single-epoch and total training time from per-step time and step count; for training scheduling, compute budgeting and iteration planning.
map.总步数 = ⌈轮数 × 样本数 / 批量⌉；训练时长(小时) = 轮数 × 样本: Total steps = ceil(epochs × samples / batch); training time (hours) = epochs × samples / batch / speed / 3600
map.把步数除以单卡吞吐（样本/秒）再换算成小时，用于排期与算力预算评估。速度为经验值: Divide steps by single-card throughput (samples/s) then convert to hours, for scheduling and compute budgeting. Speed is empirical; actual results are affected by data loading, mixed precision and communication overhead; with multiple cards multiply by parallel efficiency (usually 0.7-0.9).
map.单轮时长≈每步平均耗时×步数；总时长=单轮×轮数(+验证/通信开销)。: Single-epoch duration ≈ average time per step x steps; total duration = single-epoch x epochs (+ validation/communication overhead).
map.步数=⌈样本数/batch⌉，故增大 batch 可减少步数、缩短单轮(受显存上: Steps = ceil(samples/batch); larger batch reduces steps and shortens each epoch (within GPU memory limit).
map.分布式加速比受通信与负载均衡限制，并非线性随 GPU 数提升。: Distributed speedup is limited by communication and load balancing; it does not scale linearly with GPU count.
map.：每步 50ms、步数 313、轮数 10 → 单轮≈15.65s，总训练≈15: : 50 ms per step, 313 steps, 10 epochs -> single epoch ≈ 15.65 s, total training ≈ 156 s excluding validation. With 4-card data parallel halving steps, single epoch ≈ 7.8 s.
map.显存不够 batch 又想快怎么办？: What if GPU memory is insufficient but you want a fast batch?
map.用梯度累积模拟大 batch(不增显存)，或降低精度(混合精度)提速；也可优化数: Simulate large batch with gradient accumulation (no extra GPU memory), or lower precision (mixed precision) to speed up; also optimize the data pipeline to reduce IO waits and avoid GPU idle.
map.多半是数据加载瓶颈或通信开销。检查 DataLoader 预取、SSD/缓存、N: Likely a data-loading bottleneck or communication overhead. Check DataLoader prefetch, SSD/cache, NCCL topology; non-compute waits significantly lengthen each epoch.
